title: Thai Spaghetti Stir Fry
description: A fusion of Thai flavors with a twist on traditional spaghetti. The steamed vegetables add a nice crunch to the dish.
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, curry paste, and 2 tbsp of water. Add sliced mushrooms and bell pepper to the marinade and let sit for 10 minutes.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Add the marinated vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the snow peas and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat the remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the pan and stir to combine with the garlic and ginger mixture.
Add the cooked vegetables to the pan and stir to combine with the spaghetti.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
